scope: Preserve persisted provider identity through generic URI, artifact, complete Listing source and competitor gallery reads.
Reject a mismatched expected provider before SDK signing or storage HTTP; do not switch configuration or guess cross-provider credentials.
Refresh legacy signed URLs only with matching configured protocol, port, endpoint and explicit bucket identity.
Prefer persistent artifact URI over cached transient URL; retain inline content and unknown external URL behavior.
Decode legacy keys once; preserve literal-percent names without admitting decoded separators or dot path segments.
limitations: No true object-bucket anonymous ACL, signature-expiry denial, byte identity or joint database/object recovery has been accepted.
storage:// provider/key does not encode bucket identity; changing a bucket within the same provider still requires explicit migration/provenance.
Unproven custom CNAME/path-prefix references retain their old URL; compatibility with every historical object is not claimed.
Gallery may update synthetic subject status before signing; tests do not prove all database side effects are zero.
Positive gallery cases stop at a mocked model boundary, not completed generation. Full T25 and P1 remain pending.
